title: My reoccuring Mallworld
content: In my Mallworld, I am always drugged (nefariously, like someone slipped me something without me knowing). I become aware that I am slowly losing my ability to function. I am always unable to form coherent sentences, or I am unable to stand/walk properly. I wander the halls and get lost, even though I know the stores and the layout of the mall. Someone is always in a car trying to abduct me and I have a hard time finding my car (in real life I do not drive). Or often, someone is chasing me and I am only safe once I make it into the doors of the mall. Anyone else have a nefarious Mallworld like this?
